mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals reduced consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicate a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 3 months) increases discount rates and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy) prompts aggressive central bank policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% yoy, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous drops in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in consumer spending and investment, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market regime with high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and weak payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% monthly) reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.2% monthly, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
